translations.web: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
translations.bsb: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’
translations.kjv: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
translations.asv: even all the nations shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
